display.purpose: Screen titles, always in the serif.

title.purpose: Sheet and section titles, in the serif.

body.purpose: All copy and form input text; the 16px floor.

metric.purpose: The one number that matters most on a row (days since water), mono for tabular alignment.

code.purpose: Plant codes and other short machine-produced strings, mono.

micro.purpose: A count beside a chip, a date at the end of a history row; mono in practice.

shadows.name: hover
shadows.purpose: Hover only, never at rest — the pressed-away-from-paper half of the lift on a filled button or a plant tile.

shadows.name: over-photo
shadows.purpose: A control laid over a photograph (back button, QR button, place chip), which needs separation from an image it cannot predict. Steps up on hover.

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Genuinely floating and temporary: the drop and its fanned options, the toast.

shadows.name: menu
shadows.purpose: A menu panel opened over the page: the split button caret menu, the wishlist overflow menu.

easing.name: ease-grow
easing.purpose: One curve for the whole app — quick off the mark, long settle. Nothing springs, nothing overshoots.

hovers.name: lift
hovers.purpose: Everything pressable: the colour deepens and the surface rises 1px. Dropped under prefers-reduced-motion; the colour change still carries the state.

hovers.name: warm
hovers.purpose: Rows, menu items and nav stops: colour, background and border only. A hundred rows rising under a travelling cursor is weather, not feedback.

entrances.name: rise-in
entrances.purpose: A sheet coming off the edge it is attached to.

entrances.name: panel-in
entrances.purpose: A menu or a centred desktop sheet scaling up a hair from its own corner.

signature.name: splash
signature.purpose: Drops thrown outward from the button that logged a watering, redrawn on every press so it never becomes an icon of a splash.

signature.name: ripple
signature.purpose: The ring that spreads past the button the splash left.

motion.reducedMotion: Every animation above is dropped or reduced under prefers-reduced-motion; no state depends on movement to read.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The WATER button — the one loud, filled action on a plant screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; height: 64px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: oklch(0.455 0.104 236); color: oklch(0.985 0.004 85); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1.1875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.24,1), background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.24,1), box-shadow 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.24,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.24,1); } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-btn-primary:not(:disabled):hover { background: oklch(0.405 0.104 236); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); transform: translateY(-1px); } } .ds-btn-primary:active { opacity: 0.7; transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.455 0.098 152); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.4; pointer-events: none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: none; } }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Narrows a list. 36px — below the touch floor on purpose, since a mis-tap only changes what you're looking at. The 44px `choice` chip is the sibling that writes data.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.8 0.012 80); background: transparent; color: oklch(0.51 0.014 68); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.24,1), background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.24,1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.24,1), transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.24,1); } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-chip:hover { background: oklch(0.944 0.01 85); color: oklch(0.255 0.014 65); transform: translateY(-1px); } } .ds-chip:active { opacity: 0.7; transform: translateY(0); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.455 0.098 152); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-chip--selected { border-color: transparent; background: oklch(0.255 0.014 65); color: oklch(0.968 0.008 85); font-weight: 600; } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-chip--selected:hover { background: oklch(0.185 0.014 65); color: oklch(0.968 0.008 85); } } .ds-chip__count { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: oklch(0.655 0.012 72); } .ds-chip--selected .ds-chip__count { color: inherit; opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The shared 48px-tall field every text/number/date input is built from.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 48px; width: 100%; border-radius: 4px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.8 0.012 80); background: oklch(0.995 0.003 85); padding: 0 14px; color: oklch(0.255 0.014 65); font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; transition: color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.24,1), background-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.24,1), border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.24,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.655 0.012 72); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: oklch(0.655 0.012 72); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: oklch(0.455 0.098 152); outline: none; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: A desktop sidebar entry. Active gets a tinted fill rather than a bar or underline; hover takes on ground without rising (the `warm` utility), because a column of rows lifting under a travelling cursor is weather.

narrative.northStar: The Specimen Ledger, on warm paper
narrative.overview: Florarithm reads like a herbarium record card: names set in a serif the way a specimen label sets them, and everything a machine recorded — codes, dates, day counts — set in mono so columns of figures line up without effort. It is quiet by default so the one fact worth noticing is the only thing that speaks. The system started as a strict ledger and softened deliberately as the app grew: cards group the plant page rather than hairlines, corners are 12px and 16px where 4px read as a mistake, and round shapes are now common rather than a single exception. Shadows exist, but only for something genuinely off the page — over a photograph, over the page, or under a pointer. Colour is ink applied for meaning: leaf and water sit at the same lightness and chroma so neither competes, and ember alone is allowed to be louder.
keyCharacteristics: Serif for what a person named; mono for what a machine recorded.
One saturated colour per meaning, never colour for its own sake.
Warm, low-chroma parchment neutrals rather than true grey or true white.
Flat on paper; shadow only for what is actually above the page.
Every interactive element answers a pointer, and the answer always deepens.
One markup for phone and desktop, split by breakpoint alone.

rules.name: The One Loud Colour Rule
rules.body: Only ember sits at a visibly higher chroma than its siblings. Every other accent matches leaf and water's lightness and chroma exactly, so urgency is never implied by a colour choice alone.

rules.name: No Colour Outside the Tokens
rules.body: @theme clears Tailwind's stock palette with --color-*: initial, so bg-red-500 does not exist. A design system you can step around is a suggestion.

rules.name: The Specimen Label Rule
rules.body: A plant's own name is always Newsreader — as is any title that names a screen or a sheet, and a Section heading. Everything else is the interface sans or the mono.

rules.name: Nothing on Paper Casts a Shadow
rules.body: Cards, sheets, banners, rows, inputs and navigation are flat at rest in both themes. A shadow means the thing is over a photograph, over the page, or under a pointer.

rules.name: Round is for Controls, Corners are for Containers
rules.body: Anything that holds or writes a value — a field, a card, a row, a panel — keeps a corner. Anything you press, choose, or that marks a moment may be round.

rules.name: Hover Deepens, Never Fades
rules.body: A filled variant steps to its -deep token; an outline or quiet one takes on sunk ground. opacity dims the label along with the ground and reads as disabled — the one state a control under the cursor must not be in.

dos: Do put a plant's own name in Newsreader, and anything a machine produced — codes, dates, day counts — in IBM Plex Mono with tabular figures.
Do keep leaf and water visually equal in weight; let ember alone carry extra urgency.
Do deepen on hover, with -deep for a fill and sunk for an outline.
Do reach for lift on something you press and warm on a row.
Do use a -tint for a 'this already happened' state instead of a second confirmation UI.
Do keep every control that writes data at least 44px tall and every text input at 16px, full stop.
donts: Don't give a resting surface a shadow.
Don't fade on hover — opacity reads as disabled.
Don't round a container that holds data, and don't put a corner on a mark.
Don't introduce a fourth saturated accent; every meaning is already assigned to leaf, water or ember.
Don't write a colour, size or radius that is not a token.
Don't style a component with passed-in utility classes for anything but placement — look comes from variant/size/tone props only.
